Sales Chat

The sales assistant: outreach and email help, district and product answers, and power mapping before a meeting.
CLAUDE.AI PROJECT · OPEN FROM THE CHAT TAB

What it is

A shared Claude.ai Project built for the sales team. Primary user is Pat; Jessie uses it for renewals; anyone at STA can open it. It carries six context files covering STA's own products and leadership, outreach and objection playbooks, how K-12 districts actually buy, the house writing voice, the power-mapping research method, and the vendor-side map of Skyward staff.

What it does

  • Email and outreach. Drafts and sharpens customer messages against the STA house voice, calibrated to who is receiving them.
  • Objection handling. Answers "they said X, now what" with the play and what is actually going on behind the objection.
  • District and product questions. Who signs, which fund pays, what a product does, which Skyward platform it needs.
  • Power mapping. Calls the sales-power-mapping skill to build a pre-meeting or pre-event briefing.

How to access

Sign in at claude.ai with your @k12sta.com email and open Sales Chat in your Projects list.

What it will not do

It will not invent pricing, contract terms, SLAs, support policy or Skyward compatibility, and it will not assert that a product is compliant with any law. It will not tell you a district already runs something, because it has no access to Salesforce. Those answers come from Andy, Adam or Chris, and the Project says so rather than guessing.

Platform accuracy matters most here. VirtuaTime is Qmlativ only. Naming the wrong Skyward platform is the most visible error possible in front of this audience, so the Project asks rather than assumes.
Try this: "Draft a short email to a business official at a district whose referendum passed in November, asking what it covers on the operations side. No meeting offer."
